end.summary:
- Kunal practised retelling the story: the anklet was Mाला’s, its ghunghroo fell, and the sound stopped until it was found.
- Kunal practised answering easy story questions; a why or new-situation question is still to check next time.
- Kunal practised hearing and reading the chandrabindu sound in चाँदी and घुँघरू; some readings were right, but the sound was not steady yet.
- Kunal practised describing words and feminine agreement with चमकीली, छोटी and बजती है; some uses were right, but this was not steady yet.
- Kunal first read चाँदी as चादी, then corrected the nasal sound after practice.
end.parentNote: Asha practised the story sequence, chandrabindu words such as चाँदी and घुँघरू, and describing words with पायल. Kunal used the story clues to say that the anklet’s sound stopped when the ghunghroo fell and that it was found near the door. There was a mix-up about the chandrabindu in चाँदी, and it was corrected later in the lesson; the sound still needs more practice. At home, ask Kunal to read चाँदी, घुँघरू and चाँद aloud, then retell what happened using “पहले, फिर, अंत में.”
